questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed the half plateau? Fig. 2b calls devices I to III "three representative TSC devices" (p. 19).
Why were the other devices set aside, if there were others?
Which field ranges, sweep directions, sweep rates and temperatures did you measure beyond the ones shown? For devices II and III, Fig. 2b shows one sweep from about -40 to 290 mT at 350 mK.
What do devices II and III look like over the full hysteresis loop at 20 mK, next to Fig. 2c?
During the σ12 measurements, was the Nb bar floating, grounded or wired to its own leads, and what is the contact resistance between the Nb and the film?
Did you measure σ12 with the Nb driven normal, above its critical field or temperature, or in a device with a normal metal strip, and what value does σ12 take there?
How did you extract the plateau values and their uncertainties, for example 0.50(±0.06) e2/h (p. 8): which field window was averaged, and how did dσ12/dB in Fig. 2c set its edges?
How many reversal sweeps did you take at a fixed temperature, and do the plateau field and value repeat from sweep to sweep? The abstract mentions "many magnetic reversal sweeps" (p. 2).
